test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**surprised**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses how social inequality and child labor are normalized in India.
 
• The appropriate adjective should reflect how people are not shocked by the sight of child workers.
 
• **"Surprised"** fits well as it indicates that people are not shocked or startled by the sight of child workers, which is the context of the passage.
 
• Other options such as "afraid," "envious," and "composed" do not align with the idea of being indifferent to the sight of child workers.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Afraid" **(डरा हुआ) suggests fear, which does not fit in the context of the passage describing a lack of reaction to child labor.
 
• **"Envious" **(ईर्ष्यालु) suggests a feeling of jealousy, which is not appropriate for the context of child labor being normalized.
 
• **"Composed"** (शांत) refers to being calm, which does not reflect the emotional response to the sight of child workers in this passage.
